title: Charity Funds Grow, School Pending: filings show $1.6m held; feasibility work, supplies start
summary_full: Kai Cenat’s foundation reported $1 million in contributions in 2024, its first reported year, and held about $1.6 million in net assets by 2025. The nonprofit also reported $233,000 in expenses, including programme work linked to its education mission. As Cenat continues plans for a school in Nigeria, the project has faced land and construction challenges, with the proposed location shifting from Makoko to Yaba.
